positions.title: Software Engineering Intern

Cloud Developer Productivity Team

Modified an internal CI testing tool to be offered as a service. Responsible for the redesign and migration of the existing code with a focus on performance.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
DevOps Team

Provided support for an internal application, built with the intention of increasing efficiency of the server provisioning process by a significant margin (estimated ~700%). My work consisted of running benchmark tests to evaluate the performance of various approaches to structuring data in MongoDB, setting up database configuration settings using Chef, and writing unit/integration tests for the API.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in CIS120: Programming Languages and Techniques I. Met with students 1-on-1 every week to help them learn course material, prepare for exams, and improve their programming skills.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Application Development Team 

Alongside 5 other interns, developed a market data support website. Worked as a full stack engineer and provided feedback in code reviews.
